notes.title: BESMIRCH DEMO PATCH
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the town of Besmirch![/h2][p][/p][h3]After a short vacation, we're back at work and ready to tackle more bugs, create more content, and participate in exciting events![/h3][h3]

This patch addresses some other annoying bugs like:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Crashes during a boss fight;[/p][/*][*][p]Issues with going to sleep;[/p][/*][*][p]Getting stuck in a cave;[/p][/*][*][p]Wrong hitbox size;[/p][/*][*][p]Malfunction of audio.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3]We are currently working on a new demo version that will shift the gameplay! [/h3][h3]
It includes, but is not limited to:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Discovering the depths of the mansion;[/p][/*][*][p]Innovative farming methods;[/p][/*][*][p]Facing unknown enemies;[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocking unique items;[/p][/*][*][p]A different way to interact with villagers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Here is a little teaser of what's to come![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591965/351e8d5667d1ccdce9b664a9152632d5481af714.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We will see you in the next one![/p]

notes.title: BESMIRCH DEMO PATCH V0.2.2
notes.content: [h2]Welcome to the town of Besmirch![/h2][p][/p][h3]This is the second, bigger bug patch! Here's what we got fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]Immortal Plant monsters (Floraza's) shouldn't trap the player in their collision on death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed child walking out after player save/load[/p][/*][*][p]Baron's body crash bug[/p][/*][*][p]Old controls mismatched on save[/p][/*][*][p]Tree's triggered killing achievement[/p][/*][*][p]and many other small changes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]As for new Features we are working on (not present in this demo):[/h3][list][*][p]Snow[/p][/*][*][p]New Cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Winter monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Farming in the mansion[/p][/*][*][p]Moving all the townsfolk to the mansion during winter[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon crawling through mansion corridors[/p][/*][*][p]Much more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We'll keep you posted on any other updates and fixes![/h3][h3]See you in the next one![/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: BESMIRCH DEMO PATCH V.02
BESMIRCH DEMO ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Welcome to Besmirch![/h1][/h2]

The town of Besmirch awaits your arrival! This roguelike production combines a simple farming sim, a dark survival horror, and a touch of RPG.

Make sure to check out the trailer to prepare for the challenges ahead! 


[previewyoutube=t2rxh9WcO3s;full][/previewyoutube]

Your stealthy farming skills are crucial to the town’s survival.  

Hired by a greedy millionaire, you are tasked to manage a farm, feed the dying town, and yourself. Everything seems easy, until a mysterious dark shroud covers the whole Earth and Hell breaks loose... 



[url=https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3670630/extras/WolfAttack.gif?t=1745916534][img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3670630/extras/WolfAttack.gif?t=1745916534[/img][/url]


Here are a couple of things you can expect while playing the demo: 

*Manage your farm by tending to the plants; 

*Fight all sorts of creatures, including pesky crows; 

*Hunt using guns and traps; 

*Engage in community and befriend the questionable locals; 

*Explore various environments – from the wilderness through the Town to creepy caves; 

*Discover what hides in a luscious mansion behind its closed doors; 

*Cook a warm meal; 

And much more! 

[url=https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3670630/extras/CookingTutClean2.gif?t=1745916534][img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3670630/extras/CookingTutClean2.gif?t=1745916534[/img][/url]
